organization: General Office of the State Council of the PRC (Sponge City programme; supervised by Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development)
source: State Council General Office Guiding Opinions 国办发〔2015〕75号, www.gov.cn
notes: The 2015 Guiding Opinions on Advancing Sponge City Construction define the national programme: absorb and reuse 70% of rainfall locally; by 2020 over 20% of urban built-up area to meet requirements, by 2030 over 80%. Goals include eliminating urban waterlogging and mitigating heat islands ('小雨不积水、大雨不内涝、水体不黑臭、热岛有缓解'). It directs central and local government funding, encourages PPP, development/policy-bank credit, bonds and ABS for sponge city projects, and assigns MOHURD the supervisory role with pilots and replicable demonstration projects.
recommended_action: Target sponge-city pilot municipalities and their design institutes with flood/waterlogging monitoring, historical event intelligence and solutions_intelligence to support sponge city planning, performance assessment and PPP project documentation.
